author: MSWaddington

title: What happened?
body:
The new release is terrible,  Why? Just... why?

(Updated)

To clarify— I don’t care that you updated the user interface. I wasn’t fond of the old one. The new one has a different set of problems. Some things are better. Some aren’t. Things that used to be easy are now slow and obscure. Things I never used to do at all are suddenly encouraged and easy. So it goes. I know it’s hard to craft a UI that is simple, easy to learn, and yet reveals deeper functionality and flexibility when you need it. It’s a subjective thing, anyway. You can’t please everyone. 

What was hard to take was the surprise of suddenly not being able to use the app. No warning, no self-congratulatory, “Hey, we’ve updated the UI with these cool features” with a guided tour or something. I couldn’t figure out how to do what I’ve done easily before. It made me angry. 

I use your app to regulate attention and mood when I’m distracted, unproductive, and most of all, very stressed. Your UI designers probably already know that your customers arrive at your UI stressed and out of sorts, anxious to get their own work done and not at all prepared to have to figure out how to use your app. Or worse, learn it again. Please reflect this understanding when you change things around. The next time you make an effort to improve the UI, a little more attention to on-boarding lifetime customers like me would be appreciated. 

Having said all this, please know that, despite the UI, the sounds work. Within minutes. I also appreciate your efforts to add new sounds and new app functionality. That’s why I’m still a customer. I’m just cranky. And stressed. 

I’m gonna see if I can get your app to help me de-stress and focus like it used to.
author: Auraelius

title: Best Mind Tool App
body: I’ve learned with guided sessions, but this is different, and deeply effective for meditation and focus. Best experience I’ve had with mindful aids. I use it regularly for sleep, focus, and meditation, and can’t believe the way it settles my mind for the day. Amazing.
author: We1u12

title: Mood Selection
body:
I have used the app for a long time, and really liked the ability to choose the type of sound I wanted (Atmospheric, Electronic, etc.). I see that those options are still there, but they don’t seem to work. 

Case in point, I like listening to Focus, but I don’t want to listen to the Rain mood. So I’ll select the moods I want, but when the track changes, it will still play Rain. Doesn’t take my choices into account. Doesn’t seem to be any way around this. 

Layout is okay, doesn’t bother me, doesn’t excite me.
author: manaze

title: First to worst
body:
With the recent update I cannot recommend this as I have been doing to everyone. 
Overslept for work bc it doesn’t let alarm ring- buffering - can’t find my old favorites- just have to keep hitting next - the new interface is a mess

What was broken that made you change?

So disappointed.
author: phaut

title: It gets me focused
body:
Update: Developer reached out to me right after I posted my review below. Pomodoro function in the works everyone! Okkkay... when will we see it and can you PLEASE add white noise to the sleep channel?

Original review: Paid subscriber here. I love this app! They just came out with a revision to the app on the iPhone and the iPad and I love it. It gets me in the mood to study and back run noise when I sleep. I would recommend this app to anyone who is a student and also needs some sort of background noise to sleep with. To the developers, can you please have a strictly 8 hour airplane noise/White Noise selection? All the other options for sleep are not really helping me sleep. That would really convince me that this is a five star app. Added bonus to developers, have a Pomodoro feature added so that I won’t have to use a separate Pomodoro app when I study. Thanks!
author: swimmerguyishere

title: One of my go-tos
body: This sits in my folder of apps I try to use every day.
author: EPwood

title: Vast improvement to my sleep and study/work
body:
As to be expected, I was quite skeptical around how successful this would turn out to be. However, I am glad to report that my sleep habits have vastly improved while using this app.

I prefer the Deep Sleep over the Guided Sleep personally, mostly because I feel that I tend to focus more on the voice instead of what I’m being told to do. The Deep Sleep on the other hand puts me out hard. This is especially helpful for me as I work graveyard so sleeping in general can be a battle. This has helped a ton.

In relation to work and study. Using traditional music was always my default but I’d often get caught up in the lyrics to a song or messing with playlists thus pulling my attention away.

This tool removes that as it utilizes music that is stimulating but not in such a way that gets in front of what you’re trying to do. So far I haven’t found a “favorite” tune while working. I find this a plus since the point is focus, not music listening.

I appreciate the timing options especially during study and work as it reminds me to stop for a bit and rest, this further increasing focus when it matters.

My only complaint... It should better interact with EarPod and Beats controls. Pressing pause on the remote does not seem to do anything. Additionally, the controls are not always reliable in Control Center. I feel this is something that is likely to be addressed as it’s annoying when I’m having to fiddle with my phone to pause the music. 

Otherwise, great tool and worth the buy.
author: Disappointment sadly

title: Great app
body: I love this app so much. It helps me meditate and focus intently throughout the day. There are other types of tracks as well—like sleeping tracks—but I don’t use them because I’m already a great sleeper. In a nutshell, this app helps me be the best I can be.
author: Sharon Nicole

title: Ruined by the latest update
body: Things were amazing with this app and I had slept the best in my life but with the latest update it will either buffer and not play or only play for an hour and stop when it’s timed for 8 hours. Pretty bummed to have paid for something I can’t use anymore. And be aware if you need an alarm to wake up the next morning because now that won’t go off and I was almost late for work. FIX YOUR APP!
author: Crystal2947293

title: Redesigned App Is Killer
body: This redesigned app is killer. I was considering canceling my subscription at end of cycle. No more. It’s now *very* worth the money. As a knowledge worker who fights ADD, my Bose noise cancelling headphones + this app = better focus than I’ve ever managed.
author: Rye Jo

title: That one dinner guest who talks too much...
body:
I feel like this app is trolling me. I’m asked to focus while the intrusive guide is preventing me from doing just that, with ridiculous interruptions every 15 minutes just as I’m starting to get some effect from the music. 

The biggest mind bending issue is NO ability to turn that crap off. Before the update, I was actually able to enjoy this. So frustrating.
author: Rykros

title: Best app of all time
body: I use this for everything, the only app I’ve ever been compelled enough to review. I’d give 6 stars if I could.
author: Prairiedawg_05

title: My go-to app
body:
(I’m amending my earlier lower star review for several reasons. Please read through.)

Brain.fm is one of the apps I use all the time. Practically every day. I use it to sleep and at work to focus. I still think it’s the best app out there for focus, but the sleep portion of the app has not been good to me lately. 

There have been some update issues with the app over the past six months or so that have rendered it very difficult to use for sleep. Connectivity problems were the biggest issue. It would often stop after anywhere from 10 minutes to 2 hours. 

Then, a little over a week or two ago, they released a major update. This update missed the mark with me completely. However, I sent feedback through the app, and the team reached out to me and actually listened to my concerns. That goes a long way for me. 

The redesign is a little jarring if you’ve used the old app for a while, but it is very easy to use, and I am hopeful that the few problems I currently have with the app (like not being able to select the specific song I want without cycling through all of the others) will be fixed with a future update. 

Above all, I want to applaud the Brain.fm team for listening to feedback and wanting to make things better for their users. 

I hope to be able to update this review again in a week or two with a glowing 5 star again. I do love the product and will highly recommend it again if the connectivity issues and a few of the UI issues are resolved.
author: patricia_eddy

title: Loved it...PAST tense
body:
This used to be a great app but the latest update is horrible. No way to choose preferred tracks (thought I had, only to be rudely jarred from my work when it switched to another style with no warning). The screen is annoying and distracting, most of the previous styles are gone, the interface is entirely too cumbersome and not intuitive at all. This has gone from my #1 most-used AND most-recommended focus tool to a disappointing distraction that will no longer be used or recommended to others. 

No idea why you changed it but whatever the reason, you were given terrible advice. What a shame.
author: LBKwriter

title: Grad School and working mom
body: This got me through Grad School while pregnant and then as a full-time working mom. I graduated when my baby was 8 months old and the only way I know I did it was with the help of BrainFM.
author: PrivateReserve

title: Works really well most of the time.
body:
I actually recommend this app all the time. 

I use it when I work, when I nap and when I meditate. 

I tried using it for sleep, but that’s where it doesn’t shine.

My only complaint is the sound occasionally doesn’t loop perfectly (at least on the sleep cycles, so you get a gap of silence and then a sudden burst of sound that actually wakes me up! 

That said, it’s incredible for meditation and concentration. Using it for a 18-20 min nap feels so refreshing!

I’d love if they produced more guided meditations, they are wonderful. 

I’ve been using this app for a solid year and I use it several times a week and will continue to do so
author: Rondo Rocco

title: Improved but...
body: I do like many of the changes in the new release, particularly the options on time sets, however I am deeply disappointed to lose the option for selecting a specific sound environment such as beach, nightsounds, thunder, rain... Yes we can select a mood but after scrolling through them it appears that there are fewer available soundtracks? I’ve been unable to locate the ones I used and have yet to find one to replace them :(  considering canceling subscription
author: Casadei27

title: What has happened?
body: Lifetime subscription here. Super satisfied for several years and now naps are gone and everything else is just buffering. Absolutely useless and anything but relaxing. The exact opposite of what the app is suppose to do. Horrible update. PS - Please don’t mess with the desktop version.
author: Meppple

title: Latest redesign is Hot!
body: Loving it, devs. Thanks for the awesome support!
author: TheShrewKing

title: Account / password reset needs work
body: I’ve been a loyal subscriber to Brain.fm for two years.  The music is amazing for focus, relaxation and sleep.  Zero complaints - I personally experience the value of their music and science coming together.  But...with this recent release which logged me out, the account management capabilities, especially passwords, has gone south big time.  It is a mystery now how to update and manage your password. Needs serious work.

title: App Fail. Found better sleep option FREE
body:
After paying to use brain.fm and having the app fail 100% of the time when using it for sleep, AND trying to get a fix, I’ve now finally given up. 

I have found a much better option with an app that actually works. What a concept! It’s free and the quality of my sleep is the best result. Thanks to Relax Melodies,I finally feel rested!
author: yesitsmyrealnickname

title: Update Ruined It
body: I liked this app prior to the latest update which made it no longer free and changed the UI making it much more difficult and frustrating to navigate. Only about 1/3 of the unguided meditation “songs” I liked anyway. The others sounded like a science fiction soundtrack or had fake nature sounds. And I get that they want money from users, but I would have preferred ads over making it pay-for-play. There’s too much competition without these problems. Developers missed the mark on this one.
author: PakaLoloSwami

title: Love it, hate it
body:
The goal of this app is to put you in a relaxed/focused state. I find it is more like a flip of the coin: 50% chance of a trouble-free stream, 50% of frustration at trying to get it to work.
When it works, I love it. However, it often disappoints me as well.
I mostly use the app for focus in the office, and when it works I find it extremely helpful. The problem is that the app, through multiple updates, has had playback issues. I eventually gave up on live streaming, and simply downloaded a few streams and relied on Offline mode. The latest update deleted my offline downloads, and would not stream through an entire session. So, I downloaded a stream, put the device in Airplane mode, and now it will not play...
author: Sasane

title: Log in errors
body: There are a lot of log in errors here. L Every time I close the app, I get logged out, then my password won’t work. If I delete app and download again, then the same password will suddenly work. I have to do this process every day.
author: ftdertghu

title: Great sounds, terrible app
body:
Something’s really broken about how this app is coded. I’ve had it for years, and connectivity issues are constant. Find a sound you like? Download it. And never change. Because streaming anything may stop. Pause it? It won’t resume. Skip track? Maybe it’ll work, if you’re lucky.
With the update, now it’s not recognizing my login half the time. The fix? From the help people? Erase and reinstall the app. I’ve done that three times tonight. When it does work, it’s got a shiny new coat of UI—but it’s still hard to navigate. Change your mind about which sleep category you want? Good luck backing out! Oh, and a TINY problem remains: it still loses connection when downloading a track, won’t advance tracks, freezes, forces a new logins... which don’t work, requiring erasure and reinstalling. 
The core product is SOLID, but this app needs to be rewritten from the ground up by someone who knows what they’re doing.
author: Jorsin

title: Brain.fm is my #1 work secret
body: I get so much done when I listen to the focus music, it’s insane. A total staple in my workflow. And the new app update is AWESOME! So functional and robust, really improved UI/UX. Just want to say a big thanks to the hardworking team for bringing us all this amazing service and being tireless about constantly improving it and providing stellar support! I’m a fan for life and I tell everyone who will listen to me about how awesome Brain.fm is - not only in mission, but in actual, proven effectiveness. I get into such crazy flow when I pop on my favorite focus tracks. For a freelance designer who sometimes finds it difficult to ‘just get started’ on overwhelming/demanding creative tasks, Brain.fm has become simply essential in my daily routine. Thank you, thank you, thank you 🙏🏻
author: sarahbrown2357

title: WAS amazing...now, not so much.
body: I’ve had Brain FM for about a year now and loved it, except for the random times it would stop playing in the middle of the night. But after the update, I’m not a fan. My husband and I always played the ocean/beach waves and it played the same sound throughout the night. Now, we start off our sleep with the ocean serenity station and it plays other sounds that make us wake up. Really disappointed that we can’t just choose one sound to listen to compared to a “station” of different similar sounds. Will be finding another app now.
author: tdiedz

title: Go within (and go back to the previous version)
body:
The new purplish, smiley faces version of the app takes away the benefits of entrainment. Functions and layout are counterintuitive. Aesthetically unpleasant. 
I also shouldn’t have to login back in constantly, especially when it won’t recognize my login and I have to delete the app and reinstall.
Please go back to the previous version. Simplicity is the key. The content is fantastic. Makes sure we can access it better.
Thanks.

title: Not a good showing, folks.
body:

Also, lost all my offline tracks previously saved, and had to listen to someone talking to me about an app I’ve used for years and to which I bought a lifetime subscription.

Edit: Thanks for the response, but I still maintain the ability to pick tracks is missing. If I deselect everything under Mood except Grooves, I don’t get Grooves tracks. At least not the ones I got before that I saved for offline use. I want to actively pick tracks, especially the ones I use most often. The old version also had more choices overall.

The new UI they released in the last update is leagues better. It’s beautiful and easier to use with all of the functionality cleanly laid out. It’s a lot more clear how to download offline music.

I like to listen to music while I work but nothing that distracts me from what I’m working on which makes this perfect.

author: dunnohowitwerks

title: Love the app (with only one caveat)
body:
I use Brain.fm both for focusing and relaxing, and I’ve been exceptionally happy with it on both counts.

The one caveat: the most recent overhaul that went live in the last week added a lot of great features (love the subcategories under Focus), but also took away a vital feature — the ability to stop whatever category of music you’re in and choose another (say, switch from multi-task to creative, or focus to relax). 

Now, once you start listening to a particular kind of music, the only way to switch to a different one is to close the app, reopen it and then choose the new type. Especially frustrating since the new subcategories makes the idea of jumping from one to another as you change what type of work you’re doing over the course of the day very appealing.

title: Upgraded to pro and it didn’t update
body: Paid for pro and it still won’t give me access to the pro features. Extremely frustrated that this money went down the tubes
author: BBogusz

title: Great App
body:
Just wanted to say that so far I’m really enjoying the app but thought I’d give you a suggestion that might help to improve the user experience and even get more sales from the trial period. 

- At first glance it’s not apparent that there are multiple selections for each category. Therefore having some type of menu enabling the user to see the different choices would both give a user an idea of the number of choices available but also enable a user to easily return to a previous selection without having to press the skip button over and over until the desired selection is found and recognized. 

Perhaps an option to save favorites would be good too!
author: dwhit16

title: Instant calm
body:
I love this app. It immediately puts me into a meditative state and absolutely clears my mind. 
I have ADHD, PTSD, and severe anxiety; I am very easily overwhelmed, and my brain almost never turns off. With this app, it’s like finally feeling that relaxing, floaty clarity. 
The visualizations that come to me are both fleeting and vivid. Bright colors, clear faces and objects. Feels almost as though I’m tapping into a sixth sense. Not dreaming, because I’m not asleep- possibly hypnotized, and able to receive whatever comes to me. 
I have never experienced anything like it- and I thoroughly appreciate that my mind, for once, isn’t swarming with stress.
author: DiniVonTrapp

title: Great App
body: I especially love the guided and unguided meditation.  Also, right now I’m in the home office working with the kids outside the office playing.  If your kids are like mine,  me in the office = kids Magnet!  I just put on focus music and am able to tune them out and get some work done!
author: Justin J S

title: Constantly stopping in mid-playback
body: Been an issue forever. Never seems to change no matter how often I delete the app or logout and login. Stops in 30-minute increments. Achieves opposite its intended outcome. Very distracting.
author: Auser237

title: Not working
body: I’m a pro member and every time I log into the app, sign in and sign out, it tells me I have 0 free sessions left then tells me I’m a pro member. No help in the customer service front either! Too bad because I loved this app
author: seanb2131

title: Awesome ADHD focus, new music needed
body: I’ve used the app for well over a year almost everyday. I am severe ADHD and the music helps me focus in ways I’ve not ever found before. Incredible, seriously. But I have listened to every track about 25 times. There just aren’t that many. Devs - any new music in the pipeline?
author: bradley-g

title: Do the devs even use the app??
body:
I love brain.fm. It’s just such a shame that the app is horrible and has remained horrible for as long as I can remember.

Issue 1:
Connectivity issues.
The app doesn’t know the phone is connected to the internet. Often when switching to a different mode, from relax to focus for example, the app throws an error saying that it isn’t connected to the internet. I can swap over to a ping test or speed test and confirm there is no issue with my network connection. Swap back and it will never reconnect and keeps say there is no internet. The only way to fix is to quit out of the app and relaunch it. 

Issue 2:
Offline saving doesn’t work. 
I used to have a bunch saved for offline listening to avoid Issue 1. Then they all started to get corrupted. Since then I haven’t been able to listen to any offline or even create any. 2 phones later and the issue hasn’t been fixed. 

Issue 3:
Contacting support is a joke. 
I was a day late on purchasing a lifetime license, the deadline came and they were no longer selling them. (I had been saving for a long time because it was quite expensive) I contact them and they play hard ball and say to just pay a subscription. Yeah a subscription that’s nearly the cost of a lifetime license and will quickly out scale that. Sure I’d pay a subscription if the devs fixed the app and created new content and features. I’d pay a subscription to have good support that wasn’t so rude. But here we are and none of that exists. I’m sorry to say that I wasted all the money I saved up for a lifetime license on a subscription. 

I won’t be renewing or recommending this to anyone until all of the above has been addressed and fixed to my satisfaction.
author: ManjaroBlack

title: Still buggy years later
body:
Software is great, but app is plagued with bugs. Latest one is the continual pausing of playback. Previously, offline tracks would not play correctly (if I selected an 8 hr sleep track it would stop after 45 mins if I had also downloaded a nap track).

I’ve shared this feedback with the team numerous times, and have tried to be patient as they worked through the bugs. 2+ years is plenty of time to figure this out.
author: CJSF2323

title: Terrible customer service
body: I upgraded for the pro version within the app and the upgrade didn’t happen. I was logged out, and when logged back in I was still on the free version. I contacted the customer service immediately. It’s been almost a week, several emails and my issue isn’t fixed! I email, they reply asking for the app store receipt, I send and then no reply. It’s been twice already. I feel really frustrated because I paid $50 can’t even get a refund. When trying to report the problem to Apple, who charged my card through my apple id account, and automatic response says my problem doesn’t qualify for refund and all other options tell me to contact the app.
author: LeoZaratustra

title: Nice app but needs improvement
body:
I like this app's simplicity. You don't have to make a lot of decisions- you just pick a category and nice music starts playing. You do have limited options for your timer, though. 

The worst part is that the app is very buggy. The sleep app would make it through the entire night about one out of ten times. It usually cut out quickly. I emailed support about this. They told me to reinstall the app. I told them I did this, but it didn't improve. They never replied again. 

Sometimes, the app would also say that my wife wasn't working. But, everything else on my phone and computer was running smoothly on my home's wifi. 

I was a subscriber for about 3 months. But, I ended up finding a much better app with many more options for the same price.

title: Playback issue fixed!
body:
Like other users I'm having trouble with it stopping in the middle of a session. Im sure the dev team is working on a fix. Still enjoying the content regardless. Good luck!

Edit: looks like they fixed it

title: Needs Bluetooth connection
body: This app would easily be 5 stars if it allowed you to connect to a Bluetooth speaker especially since sleeping with earbuds or headphones on is not ideal to be comfortable.
author: FrankTheTank6390016637&

title: Limited time options.
body: Love the app. But if you meditate it had better be just 15 minutes or 30. Nothing else or in between. Primitive app in respect to time options.
author: Paul@EWM

title: Another money maker
body:
I wish Apple would require developers to list that you only get a free trial on apps like this. Yes it’s handy if you want to sample but I’m tired of everything costing so much on these apps.

title: Bought the Pro Version - Instantly Failed
body: I tried it, hit the pay wall, paid, and the app still won’t let me do anything more. Getting a refund and deleting the now useless app.
author: Adam 25

body: Title says it all, love the actual product, and the great focus tunes. The app is seriously going to make me cancel my sub, because it is that bad. Feels like a bad wrap of an even worse website. Please don’t ask me to log in if I in app purchase, don’t tell me I’m offline if I downloaded songs, and the interface needs a serious facelift. author: FossilizedCarlos

title: Pretty... but creepy?
body: It’s a little unnerving, they seemingly use the same three frequencies and oscillations for every track in it’s category. And it’s not subtle, even on low you can hear the oscillating over whichever track is playing. I’ve listened to frequency and ambient music for years and I’ve never quite felt in-a-twilight-zone-elevator-quietly-drifting-through-an-endless-void like I do with these tracks. They do however have a luxurious feel to them. The sound quality is really clean and soft and you can really feel it surround you. That aspect is what’s relaxing. It feels a little like you’re being pampered -as long as you don’t think too hard about what you’re hearing. As far as focus goes, I feel not much different and I’ve been listening for almost an hour. I feel... somewhat disturbed, as if something bads about to happen. It’s sometimes got an almost impending-doom feel, like dystopia in a crystal clean glass mansion. Good stuff guys, i’ll keep it.
author: lemsui1111

title: Suggestions 😁😁
body: Please include a detailed description of each mental state! Does recharge mean nap? Or you need more energy? I would love to see a description of what it should be used for because I don’t know. Also, the focus allows you to set the time which is very useful, and it would be great if the other states allowed you to do the same.
author: Tech214214

author: Ooooooops??!!

title: No landscape mode for iPad
body: I use this app almost exclusively in landscape mode, with my iPad on my desk at work. It would be great if I didn’t have to turn my head 90 degrees to use the app :)
author: espocode

title: More than just background noise
body: I’ve been using this app for several weeks now and see a marked increase in my productivity at work when I use it. It not only helps to drown out the distracting office noise, but the specific beats and repetitive nature of the Focus music really tunes in my mind to the task at hand, allowing me to get to that “flow” state and get a lot done, and done well. I was skeptical at first about paying for the subscription. I didn’t think the trial was really long enough to test, so I purchased a month for a longer trial and was sold on it. The next month, I switched it to an annual subscription.
author: DebClark779

title: Never worked
body:
The app never worked for me it just kept buffering then play then buffer. I focused on that rather the sound experience supposed to relax or focus me. 
It looks like the new update (after I deleted the app, the developers fixed these concerns but I don’t know first hand. I’m keeping it two stars because I could get my money back for a product I was never able to use. Two months of a subscription loss isn’t a huge deal in the scheme of things but that coupled with spending too much time trying to make it work and it never working...
author: loranutritionist

title: Love the focus music
body:
Update:
The developers have made much more improvements to the complaints I had. It’s still a little finicky sometimes when trying to play from outside the app, but the next track button seems to always work now. So I’m updating my review from 1 to 4 stars. Thanks for the fixes!

I really like the focus music but the app is just terrible! It often just stops playing. If you pause the music for just a second you can’t get it to play again unless you go back into the app and hit the Next button. Not even hitting the play button will make it play. You can’t hit play from any of the quick menus on iOS either. I’ve never seen an audio app have so many problems like this! And it’s not a new problem either, it’s been like this since I started a couple months ago. Such blatant problems I would have expected them to be fixed by now! I’ve tried giving feedback but I’ve had no response. I’m about ready to delete it.
author: Splatics

title: Useless support and pro plan on mobile
body:
Don’t waste your time.

The free version of the app is super limited.

And when you upgrade to pro, the app doesn’t update and it still thinks you’re on the free plan after paying. And your left with a big button to “upgrade” over and over again, & not able to play any more “sessions”. 

Wasted time and money. Disappointed.

And their support is useless. Super unresponsive and couldn’t look up a paying customer by email to help. 

Great app idea & tech. Poorly executed.
author: Dominator617

title: Does Not Work For Me
body: I use the Oura Ring to track sleep and have trouble getting into deep sleep.  Heard about Brain FM on the MindPump podcast.  Tried it for 1 week, with and without headphones and received no improvement on Oura Ring score.  So I have quantifiable evidence it does not work for me, but may work for others.
author: Aggrivated_Disappointed

title: Truly helping us sleep better
body: I discovered this app via heavy D and Red Beard on the heavy checklist podcast. Which is a awesome personal development podcast. I have had a hard time sleeping for a long time. I truly believe this has helped. It was almost instant. The first night was noticeably better. Well worth the fee I can’t put a price on being able to rest your brain when you can’t get it.
author: PeaceOwl20

title: Great idea but the app is a mess
body: The music is helpful, but the app pretty much obviates any benefits the music has.  If you pause the music, you can't restart it--you have to skip to another piece.
author: McSnee

title: Great when it works
body:
This app either works fine or it just stops streaming after 30 seconds. I have a good internet connection, but it just doesn’t stream well. I feel like I wasted my money on this one. 

I heard an interview with the CEO on the WellnessMama podcast, and he said when you click “next,” the AI learns what tracks work better for your brain, but I haven’t seen anything in the app related to this.
author: Kitreh

title: Lifetime subscription?
body: I like the app and the idea of playing noise to stimulate the brain to a certain state. I have felt a bit of a difference, minor but there, however I will note that I felt a tolerance to it after a while. I wish there was a lifetime subscription option to pay for it once and forget. I would also like to point out that I have, on certain occasions of prolonged listening sessions to these types of music, felt a strange ringing in my ears. It stopped coming back a while after I stopped listening to these types of songs.
author: josgurr33

title: Buggy app
body:
I love, love the focus music for writing. I haven’t used any of the other options yet. I freelance and work from home and this app has quickly become a critical part of my day to day workflow. 

BUT the app randomly stops on its own, won’t play after being paused and requires a lot of “hard shut downs” to be used all day. 

I use the pomodoro method while working so I’m pressing pause every 40 minutes for 8 hours. 

For me it’s still worth it to use, but it’s definitely frustrating.
author: Meggiebuggie

title: Trial?
body: Ran through trial in a few hours somehow and have no idea how well it works. Wouldn’t invest without better idea of efficacy. Consider week long trial
author: BillyBob222

title: Endless buffering on iPad
body: I have an old Air 2 and an old 6+, no problems on the latter, but the "buffering" on the former is so bad that I left the iPad buffering for a day and nothing ever happened.  Also, I tend to hold my iPad upside down, so the home button and speakers are at the top, but this app can’t rotate that way.
author: Muzical84

title: Stuck on “buffering” most of the time.
body: This app is supposed to help me be productive but it has the opposite effect. I have wasted a lot of time trying to get past the “buffering” holdup. The app works maybe 20% of the time. Most times it doesn’t even start any music. Other times it’ll be working fine then after a few minutes it will just stop. No reason. I’ll be sitting at my desk, on WiFi, and the app will just stop and switch to “buffering.”
author: juliaxx

title: Stops playing randomly
body: I have an annual subscription and love the concept of this app, including the variety of music styles, but the music will randomly stop playing and it's very frustrating and counterproductive. This happens when I'm streaming and with downloaded songs too. For example, I'll start an 8 hour long sleep song that I downloaded and then wake up in the middle of the night because it's not playing anymore. Just now i was streaming a 2 hour focus song right now and it just stopped 30 mins into the cycle--that doesn't do much for my focus!! I reached out via email for help and heard nothing back. Think I'm going to have to find a new app. Very frustrating.
author: Cmahler

title: Ripoff Company - run away
body: I paid this developer hundreds of dollars for a “lifetime” license - they have shut down their support and have rendered the software I PURCHASED from them useless due to inserting a fake Microsoft error - have joined a class action lawsuit group -  do you really want to support a company that steals your money and leaves you with nothing?
author: Zero star review

title: Horrible upgrade
body: I’ve twice purchased the upgrade to Pro and was billed $6.99, but the app won’t upgrade to pro???
author: Cargopete

title: Great when it works
body: As a paid subscriber I’m a little disappointed by how unreliable this app is. The connectivity issues are a continuous issue, one that the developers have yet to address. It often has nothing to do with my connection, even at great service it fails to buffer. I’m surprised the experience is so bad.
author: btheconduit

title: Lifetime subscriber
body: Previous connectivity issue has been fixed, now love the app experience.
author: Mozammel Haque

title: Crashes
body: Crashes way too much to be a reliable app. The downloading buffering speed seems to have a serious glitch preventing timely downloads for off-line listening. If they fixed it, 5 stars for sure.
author: A Slap of reality

title: It Works
body: The music works well. There is a class of songs that were maybe the original songs? that kind of phase the background in and out. Those are not so great. The more electronic and piano sounding ones are awesome.
author: AJosh1

title: Crappy app for paid members
body: Not properly styled for iPhone XS Max, audio will randomly stop, offline audio will pause and try to revert to online version if I get signal for a short moment.
author: Reviewing69420

title: Stops unexpectedly all the time
body:
Love the music so much that I consider it be highly necessary for the type of work that I do. 

Unfortunately I will be unsubscribing. 

This app stops unexpectedly all the time despite being on the newest iPhone with full bars on Verizon. 

It literally makes me angry every time I have to reach down and skip or buffer to next song. 

Music is great though.
author: Thisiskaiya

title: Actually works. App is so-so
body:
I was very skeptical despite their seemingly robust scientific process, but it turns out this actually does work very well for me. I am using it for focus. I am able to focus better and I find myself getting distracted way less often. It also gives me this weird feeling of staying super focused and determined, as if I’m trying to defuse a bomb or something.

The app is meh. Buttons aren’t very responsive. Either it’s not optimized for XS Max or the GUI is just bad. It looks like they just downloaded some cheap preexisting template and re-skinned it.
author: co92235

title: Cuts out all the time
body: Every time there is an app update - it says the app has been rewritten to improve playback. However, I still get all the same random stopping I always have. You need better developers. I’m about ready to stop paying for this.
author: Versteegta

title: Horrible app that never works. Do not purchase
body: Paid $50 for this garbage and it never works!!
author: Nojulator

title: Buffering
body: I can only get this to work on my computer. The app just spins in buffering mode for me. Canceled my sub.
author: MTQ-in-CR

title: Slow
body: I use this for almost every activity of my day: sleeping, studying, napping, relaxing, (all for which I can select the amount of time) that is when I’m not listening to music. But it has major speed issues. I constantly have to restart the app when it won’t load or when the sound stops playing. It also has issues connecting to my network most of the time. Useful, but not too reliable. Please make some bug fixes and performance improvements!!
author: Love2singa

title: Keeps buffering
body: I’ve tried to contact the developers many times to try and get this fixed but the app just keeps buffering.  Nothing works and it wasted my money.
author: chirojudge

title: Meditation, Sleep and Focus App
body:
I discovered this app when I began using a Muse headband to train myself to relax and to calm my active brain.  I’ve been pleasantly surprised at how quickly I’ve been able to get to a calm state.  My ultimate goal was to hear the voice of GOD speaking to me. I know HE is always communicating with us but we have to learn to still and quiet our mind to hear HIS Still Small Voice.  When we learn to listen and actually have an experience with HIM, we are truly blessed with an experience that is indescribable.  Words cannot begin to describe the euphoric feeling I’ve experienced in feeling the presence of GOD.  I wish the whole entire human civilization could experience this peace that “surpasses all understanding”.  

I’ve rated this app 5 stars because I have used it for sleep which was very effective and for Focus also.  In using the sounds and music, I have been able to tune out the world (with use of headphones) and use the the app as it was intended, i.e. sleep, meditation, focus, etc.  I have found it very useful and effective.  I highly recommend this app along with using the app to monitor brain waves which gives visual confirmation to the level of calm I experience.
author: txmamamom

title: Disappointed
body: I used the trial for this app and found it very helpful tho connectivity was a bit sketchy. I didn't think much of it since I'm frequently travelling and service is spotty anyway. However, since purchasing a subscription, it is worse!  I have yet to get one thing to quit buffering and play. Very disappointing.
author: Cowgalsara

title: Doesn’t buffer even on fast WiFi
body:
First, the good. I love the music and the app and really do feel like it helps me stay focused during work time. It’s amazing what it does for me. I bought a subscription because I was so impressed by how well it worked.

However, this is only useful if the app actually works. Every time I open it, the buffering takes an extraordinary amount of time, and even when it starts it only runs for ~5 min before suddenly stopping again. There is nothing more disruptive to focus than having the music cut in and out.

I’ve reached out multiple times about this and never got a response. Very close to asking for a refund for my subscription.
author: Sam.D.

title: Garbage
body: App won’t let me sign in. How is this so bad?
author: MROZ_57$

title: Sound is interrupting
body: I'm unhappy paid customer who will soon stop paying if connectivity issues will remain. Even at home with fast and reliable network brain.fm interrupt sound steam that requires only tiny channel. Fix it!
author: Tayhman

title: Waste of money, paid for Pro subscription did get any Pro features
body:
Update: Heard back from their support and they fixed my subscription issue.

This app is basicly useless after the trial. I pay for a subscription but it never activated the paid features. Request for help from the vender were not answered. Don't waste your money. It's a shame because it I got value out of the trial version of the app.
author: Zamboni1984

title: Been life changing for me
body:
I love this app. I’ve been using it consistently for over 2 years.

The focus one totally kicks in for me hard at about 5 minutes. 

The relax one puts me in a meditative state within a few mins. 

And the sleep one is incredibly effective for me. I use that one the most. 

Few feedback points though:
- the streaming feature is kinda weird so I just click the download option and listen right off the app on my phone instead of the internet.

- I wish there was an ergonomic earbud headphone they sold cause my ears can get slightly sore after awhile but it’s not enough for me to not use it. It’s like Pavlov’s Dogs. The soundtrack knocks me out very quickly which can be hard naturally for my over active brain. 

Overall, I can’t recommend this app and subscription enough. The benefits massively outweigh any minor annoyance.
author: sjlarsen

title: Unfortunate service for a great app
body:
I loved the free trial -- I travel a lot for work and I really felt like it helped me sleep. I signed up for 3 months on Jan 4th, 2019 and never received access to any additional Brain.fm plays. I emailed customer service who charged me on Jan 8th without my authorization. I replied on Jan 9th and again on Jan 16th, requesting that I hear from them no later then Jan 18th. It's now the 27th and I haven't heard anything. After failed email attempts I sent them a DM on Instagram. Nothing.

To add insult to injury, the app continues to tell me I'm out of free trial plays when I paid for a 3 month subscription 3 weeks ago.
author: khutto1990

title: So many issues - mainly paying and not getting any access!
body:
Revision: the team eventually got back to me after 2-3 weeks. They gave me an extra month and were apologetic. I do really like the app, it’s just a bummer about some of the glitches in the UX.

I’ve had some of the generic connectivity issues that other people have talked about, but the biggest one is having subscribed for pro features and being charged but not having access to any of these! I’ve had one email response from support, but having followed up now three or four times with no response I’m losing hope. It’s a nice idea but a paid app that has these sorts of problemsIs absolutely not okay. Maybe they’ll come and fix this for me, but I’m not holding my breath!
author: JamesG27NZ

title: Possible East Asian tracks?
body:
Much more stable than before! I use it regularly and find myself wondering where the time went!
Just a suggestion, but can you throw in Indian and Classical Chinese/Japanese tracks? I’ve always found them great for calming down, meditation, and for focus. Will give 5 Stars and continue buying forever with those additions! 
Thanks!
author: Slickolaz

title: Won’t register that I paid
body:
It keeps telling me that I’m out of Free Listens even though I just subscribed to 3 months.
It continues to buffer and not register that I am a paying member. 

Please help and or fix. I paid but not able to listen.
The app states that I’m a trial subscription and not a paid subscribed member.

I uninstalled and reinstalled. Rebooted. 
That did not solve my issue...

Update:
I was told to press the “restore purchases” button. Which is not present in the settings where it should be. And to log out and back in. Which holds the same result. I am still not able to listen for my paid subscription to your service.
author: JJJAYJJAYJJJ

title: Not worth paying for
body: I like the music itself. The playback is poor and music won't play continuously. Constantly have to press play after a track ends which ruins the the intended focus of the app. Customer service is even worse as they don't seem to care or respond.
author: ballmdl

title: Best App for Meditation!
body: I have tried almost all the meditation apps and this is by far my favorite. I find guided meditation very annoying, but the music in this app is awesome. I just wish it had more timer options and it updated the mindful minutes in Health app
author: Schhwinndy

title: Airplay HomePod Issue
body:
Was planning on using the app for sleeping. However when connected to my HomePod it seems to disconnect and reconnect at random times.

It is actually disturbing my sleep rather than helping it. As for Focusing if you are a AM apt Spotify subscriber, this works just fine. With the connectivity issues I won’t be resubscribing when the app just disconnects randomly
author: Guitarmaster13

title: Let’s get some workout jams!
body: Heavy bass and high cords, sprinkle some purposefully filled rhythm in there and we’re cooking! 🤘🏼
author: pthoma36

title: Cuts out like the Dickens
body: Honestly all day long on my IPhone it seems to cut out. My Mac book pro works fine so I’m guessing you guys need to apt update something in network issues on smartphone platform
author: Nicolas Ray

title: Great for concentration
body: 2019 is the year for me to stay focused and this is the app I use when reading, answering emails and coding.  I also use it as a background noise in my bedroom
author: 78twentyfive

title: Awesome. So productive.
body: I use Brain.fm as a paid subscriber. I find it essential to my daily productivity. It is also nice to be able to save tracks for offline use.
author: slackmoehrle

title: Satisfied
body: I had a little bit of problem to sign up because of my apple id email is different than the email I signed up with. I subscribed through the app store but it did not show on the app that I had a subscription. A small bug that company solved and I am happy with the service. Good customer service and good product.
author: T6nis

title: Buggy app
body: I paid but still not able to listen that app saying I should upgrade to pro. I sent email twice that i can not use app that i already paid, no response for days. Looks like bad customer service and buggy app
author: Customer10102

title: Still not optimized for notch phones
body: Another big update and still not optimized for iPhones with a Notch.
author: Mr. Feature

title: Bug fixes
body: The sounds are great! However some bugs need fixing mostly around restarting playback after alarms / phone calls etc. Also, the play button in the control center and lock screen doesn't always work
author: Hojahbug

title: Not Working
body:
App hasn’t worked in two weeks. Essentially, I’ve lost two weeks of my subscription because of this. Constantly loading or frozen.

Update, after the new update, it is still not working on my iPhone XS Max. I’ve lost over two months of my annual subscription. Downgraded to one star, looking for other options. Done with this service.
author: Randall_Martin

title: Game-changer for Productivity & Focus
body: This is one of the few apps that I will never go without!
author: Nate Alan

title: Buffering...again!
body: You would think that for an app that is essentially nothing more than a music track repeated again and again, streaming wouldn’t be an issue, but OMG it is insane how frequently I chose to turn off this app bc the “focus” has again stopped to “buffer” interrupting my focus.
author: Littlediplomat

title: Connectivity issues especially off-line with sleep app
body:
I enjoyed the focus I receive from this app. I don’t usually have connectivity issues with the focus Except 10% of the time.

I do however wish they would fix the sleep app it works really really well it works but it never works off-line. I do not want to have my phone on your my head while I’m sleeping.

CS
Los Angeles
author: C. Shayne

title: On the way to greatness
body:
I don’t really want to talk about the science and purported efficacy, just: if you are constantly looking for the “just right” ambient electronic background noise, this is it. It’s just so darn good. 

That said, the UI is sometimes a mess (things overlap, I can’t figure out how to delete accidentally downloaded loops) and it really, really loves to stall and then refuse input. Paused to talk to a coworker? Hope you weren’t digging what was playing 30 seconds ago. 

I love the loops/music and want it to succeed. Guys, don’t burn the heaps of goodwill!
author: Neurobashing

title: BEST APP EVER 🙌🏽🥰!
body: I could not live without this app!! I use it for studying, to focus, relax, meditation, and sleep. The science behind it is really cool. I was very skeptical but kept hearing great things. So glad I did!! Would recommend to EVERYONE!
author: SuperSkeptic

title: Like it, but could be better.
body: I like it. But, it drops a lot. Music stops. My largest reason for 3 stars, I want more music options I can pick from. Mix it up to the tempo I need. The next button is not enough. I subscribed, but may not renew. Downloading offline for when I travel is good, but buried in the UI.
author: Rob Rickard

title: BRAN.FM OBSESSED!
body: I am so grateful for bran.fm. I primarily use the focus function, and i can’t get enough of it. Within 5-10 minutes I’m in hyper focus for whatever I’m working on and am just overall more productive. I’ve used the meditation and sleep functions for airplane flights and I’m so happy i decided to invest in this amazing app! I’d love to see a function for when I’m in the gym. The only downside is connectivity issues and buffering out of nowhere but let’s face it, what app doesn’t do that occasionally!? Thanks brain.fm! I love this product. I recommend it all the time.
author: mindfullymel

title: Can’t use pro version
body: I loved the free trial, but when I tried to upgrade to pro I have been able to use it. It charged my card but cannot use it. I have left several comments in the feedback section but have not heard anything back. I really found the app effective, but am frustrated with not being able to use it now that I have purchased it.
author: appworkwork

title: Pauses and crashes
body: I’m having a lot of issues with pauses and crashes. Mostly pauses. When set up for two hours of listening, focus almost always pauses at a half hour. That’s very disruptive and defeats the purpose. Fix that and it’s a 5 star app.
author: Rootbur42

title: Almost Perfect
body:
Paid subscriber writing, and let me just say the choices and music is spot on.  The focus music makes me feel driven and unstoppable, and locks me into whatever I’m doing.

Only giving 4 stars now, as the app needs Chromecast/Sonos and/or other networked speakers support, and the ability to push music to those speakers without a Bluetooth connection.  

Agree it’s better with headphones, but that cast ability is the missing piece for me.  Will give five stars once that capability is added.
author: Wesmare

title: Good for relaxing and recharge and focus
body: I use brain.fm for recharge and sleep with good results. It has helped me keep my productivity up. I have been using the focus channel more with good results when I need to read technical books or solve a problem.
author: lfnst

title: Focused Workouts
body:
I decided to change up the music I listened to in the gym and wanted to experiment with using Brain.FM during my workouts after noticing results at work while using the app. I am using the Focus playlist and tend towards the heavier bass/beating drum sounds anyways. I experienced a new way to train-keeping my head in it the whole time, whereas I would previously get distracted by others, or distract myself by checking social media or emails. It has brought me to a new level of training. 

My only recommendation is to allow pause/play functionality with connected headphones and develop more of a workout based playlist (thinking of Terminator movie them sounds, drums, clanging metal, inspirational stuff).
author: PharonHolt

title: Love them!
body: Great app to focus or if your like me and have insomnia it's a lifesaver.
author: Janetdarlenexo

title: Play and go
body: I use this app day to stay focused while I build software at work. My favorite thing is I press play and forget about it for hours on end. It's pure background, never distracting, and I don't have to search for songs or manage playlists. It's an incredibly valuable tool. Connectivity had been reliable since I purchased the app several months ago. I wish I would have found out sooner.
author: Likesalmon

title: Great program, app has some issues
body: Connectivity issues with the app that cause music to stop playing for no apparent reason are the only thing keeping me from rating this 5 stars. I love the program for the focus music feature, but it plays more reliably on a computer.
author: Tifferbugz

title: Love the app, frustrated with connection issues
body: Let me start by saying that Brain.fm has been a game changer for me. The focus tracks have been so impactful that I refuse to study without it. Yet I frequently deal with connection issues like some other users report. I’ll continue to use Brain.fm, but would love if the developers spent some time resolving the connection problems.
author: Copper Phoenix

title: Wonderful!
body: App is truly amazing. Puts me in an intense work flow state when I need to get stuff done!
author: Tolooee

title: Newest version is a huge improvement
body:
Like other reviewers have stated, the older versions had serious problems with reliability (sometimes my downloaded tracks wouldn’t even play without having to first force close the app). 

But this newest version is working great so far. Very snappy performance, reliable, but with the same interface as I am used to. Great job.
author: Tim 26

title: Great app
body: Smooth and nice. Great for meditation and relaxation.
author: Carlos G.H.

title: Great for productivity
body: I got the lifetime subscription last year and have been very satisfied with my purchase! It helps me to focus on my most important work and, occasionally, to relax when I have a few minutes.
author: CowboyBibimbab

title: First time
body: I sent a text it stopped playing and now it’s been buffering for 20 minutes. I liked it for the one it played but frustration should be one of the options
author: marialease

title: Use after your workout!
body: Best recovery aid I’ve ever used! Forget the drinks or shakes...do 5 minutes of static stretching AFTER your workout and then immediately go into a Brain.fm meditation and just practice breathing deep for about 5 minutes....you’ll walk out of the gym feeling way better!! Don’t knock it til you try it!!
author: JSherd

title: Good But Needs Improvement
body: While I enjoy using the app and plan to continue doing so, it seems it’s often buffering. This forces me to either restart the app multiple times or simply go on iTunes and find an alternative.
author: Tomasz615

title: Helps me focus
body: Love the extra boost of intensity Brain.FM provides. Pro tip: download the relax or sleep before you get on an airplane and listen offline.
author: Sfnick8

title: Great, but needs...
body: a pomodoro timer.  It is a very small and simple thing that would just put this app over the top.
author: DustinDortch

title: Excellent for the wandering mind
body:
Since getting this app a few months back, I find it really helps me focus.
I love it, the only thing I wish I could do is save or favorite the songs that really work for me.  Otherwise great app and love the added genres, especially the atmosphere music.
author: audioangel

title: Love It
body: I have been a Brain.fm subscriber for a long time and I love this service. I listed while I meditate, work, study, and nap. So happy I stumbled upon this and I enjoy the new tracks being added as well.
author: adam.wardlow

title: Good at times
body: In the beginning this app worked perfectly however now I notice an annoying background sound which sounds like popping or static when attempting to use the sleep program. The problem is the noise is annoying enough to wake me up Hope there’s a fix for this
author: YourNameHere217

title: I never rate
body: App could be cleaner but whatever. The tunes are great for focusing.
author: Jcjcjcjcjcjc?

title: Best app for helping focus when you need to GTD
body: Perfect to get into The Zone when you really need to get work/studying done. Combining this app with noise-canceling headphones allows me to stay focused almost anywhere. I love the offline functionality letting you listen to downloaded music, when I don’t have good Wi-Fi access available. Company is very responsive to any feedback left via the app or website. Nice to see new types of music and features added regularly. Glad I made the decision to get a lifetime subscription.
author: JaneDAppleFan

title: Almost always buffering
body: I have a paid subscription, but it only works around 30% of the time. This is something that really should be looked into.

body: Constantly crashes. Nearly always buffering.
author: VTIsland8330

title: Awesome!
body: Really helps!
author: JDECD2E

title: Amazing! It totally works. I’m sold 🙂
body: I use this app everyday, all day. It’s simply incredible how much it helps. It helps with work. It helps with driving. It helps with quiet time. It helps my anxiety on airplanes. It helps with sleep at home or when traveling. Bonus: it helps my kids sleep! That alone is worth the price!!! The science is real folks; I hope this team continues to get funding so they can further the capabilities of this incredible project.
author: Joelkehlan

title: Its like sounds to my ears
body: It has some weird sounds and "mixes" sometimes, but the longer you use it and skip the ones you don't like it gets better.   Good for random background sounds.
author: w.j. roberts

title: Pretty good - wish it was a bit more reliable
body: I’m a paid subscriber. I do find this has a noticeable impact on my focus and productivity, and this is enough of a benefit that I’m willing to overlook other shortcomings. The app loses connectivity more often than I’d like, and I need to manually restart it whenever I get a phone call. Still, it’s beautifully done, and I’m happy to not have to hunt for background work music. It does its job well. author: Lipicapa

title: Fantastic for Focus and Sleep Alike
body:
I’m extremely happy I found this app. I used to just use calming songs through Apple Music to study with my noise cancelling headphones, but since downloading this app, for studying I largely don’t use anything else. I never realized how much background playlists like “nightsounds” and “thunder” helped until I had the chance to use it. It’s extremely less distracting than music (which I would usually need to play quietly) and generally seems to perform better at keeping me focused (I can keep the volume higher so noise cancelling is more effective). 

But not only that, the “recharge” playlist is super useful for times where you know you need a nap (as it’d be beneficial) but you just can’t get comfortable enough or relaxed enough to sleep (or at least it’s helpful for me). 

The only thing I wish is that all of the playlists had options for unlimited streaming (no timer) rather than mandatorily needing to choose a timer only to have to restart the playlist again when the timer runs out. This is a tad bit frustrating, as it’s rather abrupt to suddenly have the streaming end when one isn’t expecting it. But, overall, it’s not a dealbreaker. 

Overall, worth the download and purchase of the subscription, and I’m glad I found this app.

title: Cancellation
body:
I don’t recommend this app, because there is no way to cancel it. 

The terms and conditions say to go to Account Overview (no such menu option exists) and select Cancel My Membership. None of that is possible in the app and there are no such options?

So I finally clicked on my subscription type and it says “yeah, you are on a subscription plan” or something like that. It then says if you would like to cancel, we can’t tell how you purchased your subscription, so contact our customer support. This brings up a “feedback” window? No form, no request for any info.

I don’t respect any business that makes cancellation this difficult. It’s shady. Sadly, I enjoyed the app. However I’m not down with their method of running a business. 

Let’s see if my “feedback” can get my subscription cancelled.

title: So much potential
body:
Amazing product overall with brilliant functionality online but there’s just no good reason why the app has so many issues.  After reviewing other responses it appears that they are well aware of the fact that the app will stop playing the selected music whether streaming or if it’s downloaded.  In the offline portion of the app it frequently switches between whichever songs you’ve downloaded or just stops playing altogether with no apparent rhyme or reason. 

They usually ask for more info to get to the bottom of the issue but after so many clear concerns with the same problems you’d think they’d get it together.  Not sure if they have enough support staff to actually handle the issue yet but I hope they can figure it out.  I know it’s probably more complicated than it seems but I’ve never had issues like this with any other paid app that’s been around for a while.  Very disappointed but hopeful.

author: ReddHerring

title: Great sleep app with the right ear phones
body:
This was recommended by a successful senior leader in my company. We were sharing our favorite brain hacks for our own personal development. I am an experienced meditator and user of the Monroe instrument products. I thought this product wouldn't rate high for me. To my pleasant surprise Brain.fm won me over very fast. I quickly bought the annual subscription. 

My favorite brain.fm category at the moment is the sleep track as it has helped me once again sleep peacefully with my husband who snores loudly. With the sleep track I sleep 7- 8 hours without my normal 1 -2 times up for bathroom visits and my husbands snoring rarely wakes me. For comfort it is necessary to use specific sleep headphones such as the SleepPhones brand. I already purchased those for the Monroe audio products. 

Focus has helped me with productivity in an open concept office environment when my colleagues get too loud and distracting. I am looking forward to putting Brain.fm through the paces for meditation soon.

If you have trouble sleeping I would highly recommend this app and the paid service.
author: TelloyLinda

author: noodley5

title: Music Level

title: Poor Connectivity

author: MyHumbleReview

title: Great when the app works
body: Like many others have experienced. My biggest issue with the app is the connectivity. Unless conditions are perfect, the stars, moons and planets are aligned the app crashes. Taking me out of focus or worse sleep. Great app when it works, though.
author: chudson125

title: Good overall, some connectivity issues
body: I really enjoy this app and find it quite useful. Occasionally, the app will open but no tracks will play. I would love to have tracks for exercise if an option.
author: Maybaby@68

title: Good for concentration
body: I’m a paid subscriber and I use the app when I’m writing. For me it is a great way to provide white noise, and helps me to concentrate on the task at hand. I adjust the timer to 30 minutes from the default setting of 2 hours because I like to move around every 30 minutes. I’m partial to the rain or thunder tracks.
author: Writer529

title: Really works for me.
body: I so rarely write reviews but this one is dear to me as it has helped so much. I am happy that this company has finally made the leap to the app world and it has been worth the wait. Keep up the good work guys.
author: cook34

title: Awesome app.
body: Really helps my sleep consistency
author: DennisElonka

title: Don’t fool yourself this is just music
body: There is nothing special about their music. When you listen to it you won’t be magically focused in 15 min. The sleep tracks actually make it harder for me to fall asleep. You can pull up study playlists on youtube for free if you want music to concentrate, this app offers nothing special. All the science saying it changes brainwaves is likely hogwash because I am sure if you hooked someones brain up while listening to any music it will cause a change in brainwaves. These people are selling snake oil and try to use scientific terms and “studies” to market plain ole music that isn’t even that good.
author: Stalking cow

title: Decent app, but developer has little integrity
body: The app works alright, but when you want to cancel your subscription they make it real difficult to do so.  Subscribing is super easy though, I wonder why 🤔.  Hate it when companies do this, it’s kind of criminal really, they must be desperate for money.  Subscribe at your own risk.  Still haven’t been able to cancel mine, hopefully I won’t have to jump through too many hoops to do so.
author: JustJames.

title: Fixed my trouble with focus!
body:
I’ve always struggled with getting distracted and procrastinating on important tasks.  Now, if I just turn on the Focus music, I’m magically in the mood to do deep work within a few minutes.  Love it!

The sleep music seems to be pretty effective as well :)
author: Johnnyskyfox

title: Great!
body: Great app..connectivity issues sometimes but i know they are working on getting that fix. I use it daily
author: wjvhouston

title: Great product, horrible execution.
body: Brain.fm has a great thing going with the motivational sounds and music. I use it almost constantly. That being said, it’s totally aggravating to use the iOS app. Instead of being motivated or calm, I want to chuck my phone into a garbage disposal after attempting to use a calm session, only to have it stop every 30 seconds.
author: kofaco

title: Total game changer

author: ImBatDan

title: Not sure how it works, but it does...
body: I bought this for the Focus feature and hats pretty much all I use it for. I use Insight Timer for meditation and Brain.fm keeps me focused and moving at work. I’m a big fan and use it nearly every work day.
author: KungFuK

author: c(O_o)3

title: Excellent focus tool
body: I work in IT and often find myself working on big projects that require lots of seat time. The “music” that Brain.fm creates is excellent at keeping me focused and on task. Would definitely recommend using with headphones/earbuds that have some kind of sound isolation.
author: Awesumsawz

title: Good app although expensive
body: Helps me focus
author: Mkfarris

title: It Actually Helps Me Concentrate, Stay On Task
body: I am a paid subscriber; I’ve never had connectivity issues. This app actually helps me stay on task and concentrate well. It helps to keep me focused to work through projects. I primarily use the focus function and they have added several new tracks to the list over the few years I have consistently used the app.
author: StevOmg

title: Awesome App!
body: This app is my “go-to” to get stuff done and focus. Instead of listening to music on Pandora or Spotify while I work, now I turn this on and am able to tune everything else out. I primarily use the focus tracks, but the Nap and Relax ones are great too. Unlike other reviews, I have experienced ZERO connectivity issues. Well worth the year subscription!

title: Great for focus... when it works
body:
I have had some streaming issues with the app to keep music playing during better after I 
re-downloaded it was better.
author: Sinnerstevie

title: Every day
body: I use this every single day to work in noisy environments and I’ve never had any trouble with it. I really love this app.
author: Psmdtg

title: I have no idea how this works, but it helps
body: I’ve always had a hard time falling asleep. Listening to this seems to calm my mind and let me drop off. Been using the focus part at work too. Seems to help with the afternoon slump.
author: ConBrio78

title: You have come along way
body:
I started to use Brain.fm a couple of years ago. I almost exclusively use the focus to enhance my focus and work performance. It is better than caffeine.

The design has finally caught up. No more web based application for me. No more beta.

A great application that keeps on giving.
author: Throtol

title: Needs more options
body: I love love this app! My only complaint is that there are not more time options in the nap and meditation functions: in the nap function there should be 1hr and 1.5hr options, in meditation there should be 15 minute increments up to an hour or 1.5 hours.
author: babyZENmama

title: Some issues but highly effective
body:
Connectivity problems sometimes and can be a bit wonky when comnexting to bluetooth.   Seems to be more reliable of late.   I am a paid subscriber.

Focus -  have found it very effective.   I am usually playing it 4-6 hours a day but notice an effext within 20 min.

Sleep -  has not worked well, but my sons seems to be more in tune with it

Meditation -  very effective.  Have used it to meditate in the car (i have a driver).    I fee it makes getting into the zone easier when using at home.

Overall i would highly recommend
author: krishChiv

title: Customized session length
body: I enjoy the app, but would really like to be able to customize the session length.  The current options are not granular enough.
author: BHmax12

title: One of my staples
body: I use this app every day at work and sometimes at home. This is one of those staple apps that I’m not sure how I got by before it was created. I mostly use the focus music, but the meditation music is amazing as well. I just wish there were some more comfortable headphones on the market to listen to the sleep and nap music.
author: lathibad

title: Truly remarkable!
body: I have been using Brain.fm for several months. I have used it for focus, sleep, and meditation. I find them all to be effective. I like to download the songs, because I have limited bandwidth and can’t support streaming all the time. I find that when listening to a sleep soundtrack I would wake up and the music would have stopped. I wish that the download tracks for focus would be longer then 30 minutes. I am aware of the 25 min on 5 min off concept, so maybe that was taken into play with the short length of the downloads. The app really does do wonders for concentration, meditation, and sleep. Overall, I would highly recommend.
author: bkitchen07

title: Literally saved me from losing my job
body: ADD makes it difficult to focus at work, but when it gets particularly bad I force myself to use this app and it’s like it turns on a focus switch in my brain. Thanks guys!!
author: Baxter522

title: Awesome
body: I love Brain.fm-great to focus with while at work and great guided meditation. Listen to this everyday!
author: davidryther

title: Great app!!
body: I have been using Brain.fm for the past several months - the focus channel works amazingly well.
author: MikeD12@

title: Perfect
body: Love it all. Wish they would add workout music too.
author: SamanFakhreddin

title: Be prepared to pay.. a lot
body: Very nice app that works well. It will work for a few times, then want you to pay $50+ a year. That was a bit letdown, especially since it quit working half way through the night.
author: A Earhart

title: It flat out works
body:
Brain.FM 100%, absolutely works. Within minutes of listening to a specific track, you begin to notice the effects. What I mean by that is when you listen to a track intended to help you focus, your brain will begin to do just that allowing you to be more productive. And it’s not just enhancing your already focused brain, you could be completely out of it and by listening to a track, reframe your state of mind to be focused! 
Yes, the app has its faults and areas to be improved but these mainly come down to minor annoyances. The product is stellar and completely out weighs any app issues.
author: P_Lew23

title: Connectivity and Bluetooth problems
body: I love this app and use all the modes. I’ve been having issue with it halting my playback in my AirPods while the tracks continue to play, no audio in my headphones. Also connectivity issues, buffering will just stop and not pick back up. Needs some tech/big updates, I’ve noticed a positive impact on both my focus and sleep.
author: CAM_Bam_0000

title: Game changer!
body: I first heard about this app on podcast. Tried the focus in the morning and was blown away. I have a hard time reading longer then 30 minutes, now with Brain.FM I can read as long as I need. My only complaint is that I am late for work because I get too focused and lose track of time :-) Strongly suggest trying this app!!!
author: Rowan the boat

title: Great, but connection seems horrible
body: Fix the connectivity issues and I will resubscribe and rate 5 stars. Love the app but connection simply isn’t consistent enough.
author: Jkokoski

title: Wow!
body: I love brain.fm it really helps calm you down after a long workout, meditation, or just a short nap.
author: N8CHOLAS

title: Great concept, lacking execution
body: When the app works properly it awesome. I genuinely feel a difference in focus and relaxation when listening to the music. Despite the bugs in the software I still use it daily. This company should probably hire some new devs though because there are just unacceptable issues with the software. Biggest problem is just the app randomly pausing, then having to open it back up and start playing it again. Also offline mode is pretty weird. Some of the songs that I have downloaded don’t seem to be available through the explore menu. So somewhere there is a disconnect in categorization. I get the idea of designing an app to be stupid simple but I need just a bit more control over things. Maybe I’d like to relax more than 30 minutes. So I think it’s a worthwhile download for the content rather than the lacking app experience.
author: athebear

title: Like the tracks, but connectivity issues are nonstop
body:
I exclusively use the focus tracks, and consistently have had connectivity problems. Sometimes it won’t start up at all, and often it cuts out in the middle of a track.

I really do think these are helpful, but the connectivity issue is starting to become a real point of frustration.
author: Boum987

title: User for almost a year
body: It gets my work mojo going when I need the extra boost. I also use it for relaxation and meditation but the sleep feature doesn't quite work for me.
author: Mubblefubbles!

body: Gets the brain in focus mode for building financial plans better than vitamin B. When I need a rest, 15 minuted relax is great. I sleep well however, have used the sleep when traveling and it works.... I normally do not sleep well in hotels. FYI: In 2 years of daily use, NEVER had a connection issue that was not related to local WiFi or bad cell reception. I think people are a little ignorant as this is a streaming app and it should not be blamed for poor reception.
author: GrouperKing

title: Amazing app

The guided meditations are wonderful and there are a lot of different songs to pick from across all mental state options. I recommend this app to anyone from a beginner to a seasoned practitioner. Great app!
author: CJPruz

title: Awesome!
body: Brain.fm has helped my focus and sleep so much. It’s a game changer.

title: It works!!

author: galangsternation

title: Awesome
body: I almost always have my headphones in while I’m working. I would get distracted and lose my train of thought when I’d listen to some songs as I would sing along with the lyrics. Due to the distractions I would run into while listening to my favorite artists or the Top 100 playlist, I started to look at different types of music, music without any lyrics. I was listening to a Mind Pump podcast with the CEO Dan Clark and was sold. I use brain.fm all the time while working, now. Definitely recommend!
author: mfawc4

title: Great for focus, meditation, and sleep.
body: It helps everything. For sleeping, a comfortable head band type of head phones is essential though.
